verdict.rationale: Figma publishes an official OpenAPI specification, along with TypeScript types, for its REST API in the figma/rest-api-spec GitHub repository, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The probe found no spec at conventional paths on developers.figma.com, but that only makes it less discoverable; it does not contradict the GitHub repo. Missing for 10: discoverability at standard well-known/docs paths, and documentation or corroboration beyond the single README mention.
